title: Token-2022 transfer hook
detects: An authority that can install an arbitrary program which runs on every transfer of this token and can cause the transfer to fail.
knownFalseNegative: A null programId means no hook is installed right now. It does not mean none can be, and installing one takes effect immediately with no delay, unlike a transfer fee change which is scheduled two epochs ahead. A dormant transfer hook is therefore a faster route to blocking every transfer than a dormant fee is to taxing one. The reverse case is worse still and is why this pattern scores on the extension rather than on any field: a null authority with a non-null programId means the hook is installed and can never be removed.

coversExamples.observed: PRESENT, authority 2apBGMsS6ti9RyF5TwQTDswXBWskiJP2LD4cUEDqYJjk with programId null: no hook installed, a live authority able to install one

rationale: Reading only programId would report a token whose owner can halt all transfers at will as having no transfer restriction whatsoever, which is the same error as reading paused() and reporting no pause mechanism.
